title: Coordenador (a) fiscal
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Coordenador Fiscal, você irá:

Atuar na área Financeira, conferindo as apurações de impostos, tais como: ICMS, IPI, PIS e COFINS, analisando a veracidade da documentação, cálculo, análise técnica e valores, aprovando e verificando as guias; supervisionando e controlando as atividades de escrituração fiscal e apuração de impostos e taxas, bem como verificando e analisando relatórios fiscais; preparando requerimentos de solicitação de certidões e de opção por regimes especiais de tributação junto a órgãos públicos; elaborando obrigações acessórias, bem como realizando demais atividades correlatas e inerentes ao cargo.

  • Gestão de Equipe e motivação.
  • Conferir as apurações de impostos, tais como: ICMS, IPI, PIS e COFINS, analisando a veracidade da documentação, cálculo, análise técnica e valores, aprovando e verificando as guias de ICMS e DARF's, com a finalidade de garantir o cumprimento das obrigações legais. Orientar o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e tributárias, supervisionando e controlando as atividades de escrituração fiscal e apuração de impostos e taxas, bem como verificando e analisando relatórios fiscais. title: Corporate Communications Expert
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China!

Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

About the Role:

Keeta is looking for a Corporate Communications Exper to support the execution of our external communications strategy in Brazil.

You will work with media, PR agencies, and cross-functional teams to implement campaigns, manage media relations, and maintain brand consistency in a fast-paced tech environment. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented executor with strong organizational skills and experience in media engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Campaign Execution: Support the rollout of integrated communications initiatives (press releases, media pitches, events) to enhance brand visibility and positive media coverage .
  • Media & KOL Coordination: Assist in managing relationships with journalists and influencers, including scheduling interviews, sharing updates, and tracking coverage .
  • Agency Support: Work with external PR agencies to coordinate deliverables , ensuring alignment with Keeta’s messaging and deadlines.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Marketing, Social Media, Government Affairs, and Internal Comms to implement consistent messaging across channels.
  • Crisis Response: Help monitor and address reputational risks, including drafting holding statements and supporting rapid response efforts.
  • Content & Reporting: Prepare press materials, media lists, and performance reports (e.g., coverage metrics, sentiment analysis).

Requirements:

  • Experience in corporate communications or PR experience , preferably in tech, food delivery, or related sectors .
  • Experience supporting media campaigns, agency coordination, and crisis comms .
  • Strong written and verbal communication in Portuguese and English .
  • Organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Familiarity with food/beverage or delivery industries is a plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: RELATIONSHIP MANAGER - GERENTE DE RELACIONAMENTO
description:
RELATIONSHIP MANAGER

SAO PAULO, BRAZIL

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Hours: Fulltime, 40 hours per week.

Who we are:

Corpag is a dynamic and international boutique trust and corporate services provider. Our goal is to remain relatively small-scaled, so that we can continue to distinguish ourselves with the personal services we offer to our clients.

Though legislation varies in different countries, Corpag’s ethical code is strict and equal worldwide. We are very happy to help companies and private individuals that are, just like us, entrepreneurial, transparent and earn their money in a sustainable and responsible manner. We are here to optimize their business and be part of their success.

At Corpag we put high emphasis on our ESG policy, by always focusing on people and the environment, in anything we do. This drives us making clear and transparent choices on the industries and clients we want to work with. As we have been a successful and healthy company for over 50 years and as making money is not our main goal, we are in a privileged position of being selective in which type of client we want to work with.

The Relationship Manager will be part of our Brazil team. The Brazil team is a cross-functional team with different backgrounds and diverse skills and perspective, handling challenges for our Brazil client portfolio, working closely together with multiple of our on- and offshore jurisdictions worldwide.

How we see you:

As a Relationship Manager, you will have the opportunity of representing Corpag towards clients and you will play a crucial role within the private and corporate client sector in Brazil. You will be entrusted with maintaining close relationships for the company with existing referral partners (feeders) and clients and ensuring legal good standing for the corporate and private structures of our clients.

Your key tasks and responsibilities are:

· Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with high-net-worth individuals, family offices, corporate clients, and intermediaries, ensuring trust and long-term engagement. Identify and pursue new business opportunities with a focus on existing clients and intermediaries such as lawyers and tax advisors.

· International Structuring: Manage clients’ international structures (trusts, foundations, companies) tailored to their wealth planning, asset protection, and tax optimization needs, while liaising with legal, tax, and fiduciary professionals internally and externally across jurisdictions to implement and manage these international structures effectively.

· Regulatory Compliance & KYC: Ensure full compliance with Brazilian and international regulations, including thorough Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) procedures.

· Client Onboarding: Manage the onboarding process for new clients, including documentation, due diligence, and coordination with internal teams and offshore offices.

· Portfolio Oversight: Monitor and review client portfolios and structures regularly to ensure they remain compliant, efficient, and aligned with client goals.

· Reporting & Documentation: Prepare regular reports, meeting notes, and file reviews for clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring transparency and accountability.

· Internal Collaboration: Work closely with global legal, finance and compliance teams to deliver seamless service and resolve client issues.

We offer a varied job in an international boutique style company with an informal culture. Continuous training (tax, legal, AML and soft skills) will be part of the job and opportunities are there to develop further, in Brazil or perhaps in one of Corpag's other international offices in due course under our internal Global Mobility Program.

What you should (ideally) bring:

Ideally, you bring the following experience and interests with you:

  • Legal background (university degree);
  • 3+ years of experience in professional services, preferably in a Trust Company, Private Bank, Multi Family Office or accountancy or law firm;
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and convincingly, verbally and in writing, at all levels of the organization and externally. Within Corpag the main professional language is English. Fluency is Portuguese and English is required.
  • Initiative-driven, solution-oriented mindset with a focus on accurate knowledge sharing, with demonstrated capability to plan and manage resources effectively.

What we value:

He who does not advance, goes backwards. And going backwards is not the way to go at Corpag. We want to go forward. Grow. Spread our wings. Safeguarding our existence while looking ahead. That also entails planning ahead.

At Corpag we attach great value to the competences of our employees. We expect you are familiar with our shared priorities and that you are strongly working together with others. You are a specialist in your area of expertise. A constant focus on integrity is part of everything we do.

What we offer:

Chance to be part of a steadily growing global organization with the highest ESG and fiscal integrity standards in our industry.

title: [Fully Remote] Front End Engineer (React, TypeScript)
description:
About Oleve

Oleve builds and manages a suite of mobile and web products that power experiences for millions of users worldwide. We combine thoughtful design, strong engineering, and data-driven iteration to create software that is fast, beautiful, and reliable. Our tech stack spans  Next.js ,  React Native , and  Python , allowing us to deliver consistent experiences across devices with shared components and a unified design system.Role & Purpose

As a  Design Engineer at Oleve, you’ll sit at the intersection of design and front-end engineering — crafting visually stunning, high-performing, and accessible user interfaces. You’ll bring our brand and products to life through motion, interactivity, and thoughtful systems that scale across our ecosystem.

You’ll collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers to implement creative, performant solutions for both web and mobile. This role blends design thinking with technical rigor — ideal for someone who loves to code and cares deeply about visual polish and user experience.

What You’ll Do
  • Partner with design, product, and engineering teams to ship world-class interfaces across Oleve’s web and mobile products.
  • Build and maintain our shared  design system in React and React Native, ensuring a cohesive visual language and UX across all products.
  • Translate complex design concepts into responsive, performant components using  Next.js and  React Native .
  • Lead and contribute to front-end architecture discussions, focusing on accessibility, Core Web Vitals, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to design efficient API integrations and end-to-end user flows.
  • Mentor other engineers on UI craft, motion design, and design systems best practices.
  • Experiment with new technologies, animation techniques, and tools that enhance design-to-code workflows.
  • Work closely with marketing and growth teams to deliver fast, scalable, and visually refined campaigns or landing pages.
About You
  • You have 3+ years of experience in front-end or design engineering roles, ideally within product-focused teams.
  • You’re fluent in  React ,  Next.js ,  React Native ,  TypeScript , and have a working knowledge of  Python or backend APIs.
  • You’re comfortable in  Figma and can collaborate effectively with designers from concept to launch.
  • You have an eye for detail — typography, spacing, motion, and interactivity all matter to you.
  • You understand performance, accessibility, and SEO, and know how to balance technical trade-offs.
  • You’ve worked in a  multi-product environment and can build systems that scale across multiple apps.
  • You’re comfortable working with  analytics (Mixpanel, Amplitude) and using data to guide design and UX decisions.
  • You thrive in collaborative environments and can comfortably move between creative and technical conversations.

title: Senior Developer - Java
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior Developer - Java

You will start your day on a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goal with your team. You will spend most of your day designing, developing and testing your code and supporting your team members. You will be able to deploy your code in production using automated continuous integration and continuous deployment.

You will work with product managers, analysts, architects, and engineers to plan, design, develop, test, and implement information technology solutions.

Hybrid work model, office in Porto Alegre Office location.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open-source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience on web application development.
  • Advanced English;
  • Advanced understanding of frontend development using JavaScript frameworks.
  • Experience with technologies Java;
  • Know best practices around software development, SDLC, unit testing, frontend performance tuning, be able to share this knowledge with others in the team.
  • Experience using CI and CD pipelines
  • Technical Analysis – analyzing systems, problems, programs, formulating solutions.
  • Technical Design – ensuring that all work undertaken is of sound design and fits in with the existing architecture.
  • Participates in requirements gathering and reviews, assesses technical feasibility, assists in defining solutions, and prepares development artifacts where required.
  • Conducts code walk through and reviews with team members.
  • Monitors changes in technology; remains up to date on current industry trends and internal architecture practices, principles, models and standards; trains technical staff on new technologies.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

title: Analista de Segurança CSIRT
description:
NOSSAS PESSOAS, JUNTAS, LIDERAM COM CONSCIÊNCIA.

Na Natura, temos potencial para impulsionar transformações significativas. Isso é possível por meio dos produtos inovadores da Natura e Avon; das experiências marcantes dos serviços de beleza da Bluma e da nossa plataforma de educação financeira, a Emana Pay. Marcas e serviços relevantes para quem os utiliza e reconhecidos pelo nosso compromisso com a condução de negócios regenerativos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Criar e conduzir planos de resposta a Incidentes;
  • Acompanhar e direcionar as ações das salas de crise para contenção de incidentes críticos de segurança.
  • Criar e atualizar as documentações de lições aprendidas para atender novos incidentes identificados no ambiente.
  • Assegurar as criações dos runbooks e playbooks com os times técnicos e SOC;
  • Conduzir pesquisas, investigações bem como identificar ameaças;
  • Automatizar controles relacionados à resposta a incidentes;
  • Acompanhar e assegurar a governança das tratativas relacionadas às vulnerabilidades de Infra e Cloud;
  • Suportar os casos identificados pelo time de Threat Intelligence;
  • Acompanhar e desenvolver indicadores da área provendo melhorias no ambiente.
  • Identificar falhas e riscos de segurança por meio de controles análise dos sistemas e equipamentos da Pay.
  • Estabelecer controles e monitoramento nos acessos e na criação de novas funções, alteração em funções, objetos, campos de autorizações e parâmetros de acesso a sistemas de informação
  • Conduzir os trabalhos com consultorias contratadas (co-sourcing).
  • Acompanhar os pontos de auditoria em aberto (FUP) assim como, realizar testes para identificação da efetividade da correção do risco/apontamento.
  • Criar dashboard/cockpit de cyber security, para unificar as informações das diferentes ferramentas do time em um lugar único.

Quais os Requisitos?

  • Conhecimento em controle de acesso AWS
  • Conhecimento nos frameworks: MITRE, NIST
  • Experiência com resposta e tratamento de Incidentes
  • Conhecimento em projetos utilizando métodos ágeis
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura, redes e operações de segurança (MSS e SOC)
  • Conhecimento de gestão de vulnerabilidades e ferramentas que suportam a gestão.
  • Conhecimento em normativas e melhores práticas relacionadas à SI: GDPR/LGPD, SANS - CIS, ISO 27001 e 27002, PCI).
  • Conhecimento em serviços de segurança em nuvem - AWS (core) e Azure
  • Experiência na gestão e/ou implantação das tecnologias de segurança como: Firewall, Security Group, IDS, EDR, Antispam, filtros de conteúdos, DLP, WAF,PAM, DAM.

O que você vai encontrar por aqui?

Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. Além de oferecer benefícios voltados ao bem-estar social, físico, financeiro, mental e emocional, promovemos um ambiente de prosperidade, pertencimento e propósito, fortalecendo uma rede sólida de apoio, expansão de consciência e respeito à diversidade, equidade e inclusão.

Somos um movimento que transforma a maneira de viver e fazer negócios em 14 países da América Latina, sempre guiados por consciência.

Conhece alguma pessoa aqui na Natura?

Se sim, peça o e-mail corporativo dessa pessoa e, ao se inscrever para uma vaga, utilize-o para solicitar uma recomendação. É uma excelente oportunidade para fortalecer sua rede de contatos e avançar no seu processo seletivo em nossa empresa!

A Natura celebra e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades.

Convidamos #Mulheres, #PessoasNegras, #PessoasComDeficiência, pessoas da comunidade #LGBTQIA+, #Gestantes e pessoas com #50anos+ a se candidatarem para esta vaga!

title: ENGENHARIA DE PLATAFORMA TI SR em CICS - PLATAFORMA MAINFRAME SOLUCOES DE INTEGRACAO
description:
Vem ser Ituber & vem fazer Itaú

O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 60 milhões de clientes em 18 países. Não queremos você apenas por achar que tem a nossa cara. Queremos ter um pouco da sua também!

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de ANALISTA ENG PLATAFORMA TI SR em CICS - PLATAFORMA MAINFRAME SOLUCOES DE INTEGRACAO , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.

  • Instalação, customização, gerenciamento, evolução e suporte ao software IBM CICS e correlatos

  • Interação contínua com outras áreas, como Operação Mainframe, Governança e Comunidades
  • Se relacionar com a IBM para tratamento de assuntos técnicos, POCs, aplicação de FIX e melhorias.
  • Realizar integração de ferramentas e atuar em modelo ágil

title: Consultor(a) Tributário (ICMS)

title: Government Affairs Senior Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China!

Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced Government Relations Manager to oversee our interactions with state and municipal governments and manage relationships with industry associations. This role is critical for building and maintaining effective partnerships that support our organizational objectives and enhance our public policy initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with state and municipal government officials to advance organizational goals and policy priorities.
  • Monitor regional legislative and policy developments, analyzing their potential impact on our operations and providing strategic recommendations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with key industry associations, fostering collaborative partnerships and advocating for shared interests.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align government relations strategies with business objectives, ensuring cohesive integration and compliance.
  • Represent the organization at governmental meetings, public hearings, and industry association events, advocating for organizational positions and strengthening partnerships.
  • Prepare briefings, reports, and presentations for senior management, highlighting opportunities and challenges in state and municipal affairs.
  • Identify and mitigate potential government-related risks, developing strategies to address them proactively.

Requirements:

  • Relevant experience in government relations or a related field, with a focus on state and municipal affairs and association engagement.
  • Proven ability to build and manage relationships with government officials and industry associations effectively.
  • Strong understanding of regional political landscapes and public policy processes.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of articulating organizational positions clearly and persuasively.
  • Demonstrated experience in successfully managing and advocating for public policy initiatives at the state and municipal levels.
  • Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Political Science, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Desenvolvimento Java AWS - Pleno - 124105
description:
Sobre a vaga

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.

O que estamos buscando?

Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior

Requisitos:

  • Desenvolvedor Java experiente e com conhecimentos em Amazon Web Services (AWS) para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações robustas e escaláveis em Java, integrando-as com serviços na nuvem AWS.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java 8/ 11+, incluindo frameworks como Spring, Spring boot, Hibernate ou Java EE. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros. Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a serviços (SOA). Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (por exemplo, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB). Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação, como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou AWS CodePipeline. Conhecimento em containers e orquestração, como Docker, EKS e Kubernetes. Experiência com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation. Habilidade para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente e colaborativa. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas. Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, como AWS Certified Developer ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Conhecimento em segurança na nuvem e boas práticas de proteção de dados. Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful. Contribuições para projetos open source ou participação em comunidades técnicas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;

Descrição comportamental:

title: GenAI Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a Software Engineer focused on Artificial Intelligence, you will make a significant contribution to the construction of innovative AI Agents by collaborating closely with your engineering peers. This role requires a high degree of creative thinking and a strong willingness to learn, as you will be working with the latest in Generative AI tools and frameworks. The Agentic AI Engineer explores emerging technologies, promotes new development approaches, and helps shape the standards for intelligent automation, playing a fundamental role in advancing the company's AI-driven solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of autonomous AI Agents, leveraging LLMs, advanced techniques such as RAG, and agent-specific frameworks;
  • Develop full-stack applications that support and interact with AI Agents, using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Next.js to build the necessary interfaces and systems;
  • Explore and experiment with emerging technologies and frameworks in the agentic space, fostering innovation and shaping best practices;
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to define the behavior, capabilities, and goals of AI Agents, translating business requirements into robust agentic solutions;
  • Ensure code quality through rigorous reviews, testing, and documentation, while mentoring other engineers on development best practices.

Essential Skills

  • Solid experience in software engineering, with proven expertise in writing clean, maintainable code and leveraging modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure quality and automate delivery;
  • Hands-on and up-to-date knowledge of Generative AI, including experience building and implementing features with LLMs in real-world products;
  • Strong foundation in software engineering principles, including system design, API architecture, code quality, and testing.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience in designing GenAI solutions architecture, agent frameworks, and advanced techniques such as RAG;
  • Knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP) applied to production-grade systems;
  • Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, including proficiency with modern frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or CrewAI for the purpose of building, testing, and deploying autonomous, goal-oriented agents.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Regional QHSE Compliance and Data Manager
description:
This is a crucial role in QHSE data analysis to ensure workplace safety, compliance with regulations, and driving continuous improvement in QHSE performance.

The individual will be part of the regional QHSE team responsible for strengthening the QHSE team by maintaining a skilled and knowledgeable workforce (local team leaders and QHSE staff) with a focus on operational compliance, site investigations, remediation, and property assessments. Key duties include improving team expertise in the QHSE Management System, overseeing the effectiveness of actions implemented as result of risk prevention, incidents investigations and audit programs.

1. Data collection, management and analysis:

  • Collect and compile QHSE data from various sources, such as incident reports, audits, inspections, training records, and environmental monitoring systems.
  • Develop and maintain robust databases and data systems to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Conduct daily and weekly reviews of QHSE and sustainability data to identify anomalies, discrepancies, or potential errors, ensuring data integrity.
  • Analyze QHSE data to identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement in safety performance, quality outcomes, environmental compliance, and overall QHSE management.
  • Perform data extraction and mining to identify trends and check for errors.
  • Utilize statistical methods and data visualization tools to interpret data and extract actionable insights.

2. Reporting and communication:

  • Prepare reports and presentations to communicate QHSE data trends and recommendations to management and stakeholders.
  • Provide data-driven insights to improve QHSE and sustainability performance.
  • Collaborate with teams to support improvement initiatives.
  • Present findings to various audiences.

3. System and process improvement:

  • Analyze current and future data system needs to improve data management and reporting.
  • Implement solutions to streamline data processes.
  • Assist in developing and executing QHSE policies and procedures
  • Conduct training on software and create training content for QHSE data requests.
  • Promote company QHSE processes through training and documentation reviews.

4- QHSE control and assurance of our Integrated Management System according to ISO 14001, ISO 9001, ISO 45001 and ISAGO.

  • Provide feedback to sites through on-site audits, inspections and informal reviews to ensure that site MSM procedures are properly implemented
  • Work with sites to identify risks presented by operations and propose recommendations. Where required, attend or lead process hazard analyses as QHSE subject matter expert

Qualifications and Competencies:

  • More than 5 years of progressive experience in EHS leadership, incident reduction in heavy industries like aviation, manufacturing or construction, etc
  • Strong leadership experience ideally in a multi-cultural, international business environment.
  • High experience in risk assessments, accident/incident investigation and root cause analysis
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience with statistical analysis.
  • Understanding of QHSE management systems and regulations.
  • Communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to deal with a wide range of situations and personalities, good interpersonal skills
  • Able to work well under pressure and maintain a team spirit and cooperative attitude
  • Able to conduct public speaking, good presentation skills
  • Detail-oriented, excellent organizational skills and consistent
  • Strong verbal, auditory & written communication skills.
  • Computer literate, with proficient skills in MS-Office suite of programs.
  • Willingness and ability to frequently travel, up to 40% sometimes with little notice
  • Fluent command of English and Portuguese or Spanish (middle level and up)

This position Reports directly to the Regional Head of QHSE Latin America and Caribbean

description:
Resumo: Coordena os processos de desenvolvimento de projetos, levanta necessidades e requisitos, acompanha cronograma, desenvolve planilhas e apresentações e controla documentações.

Responsabilidades e atividades principais:

  • Receber a documentação referente a abertura de novos projetos e preparar o detalhamento do processo, emitindo comunicados de abertura e informando às áreas envolvidas;
  • Especificar o escopo do projeto, informar as equipes envolvidas tanto da empresa como do cliente, preparando planilhas para definição do cronograma e custos do projeto e submeter ao superior para aprovação;
  • Elaborar planos de execução, comunicação e acompanhamento do projeto;
  • Garantir que todas as informações e acontecimentos do projeto serão registrados e estarão em um local de fácil consulta;
  • Realizar solicitações de compra de materiais necessários para a execução do projeto;
  • Verificar e certificar que todas as fases do projeto sejam cumpridas desde sua montagem e teste até entrega do equipamento ao cliente;
  • Analisar e identificar possíveis riscos ao projeto, auxiliando na identificação de estratégias de prevenção e diminuição dos mesmos e reavaliando desde o inicio até o final;
  • Planejar, monitorar, administrar os projetos , analisando as documentações pertinentes , garantindo que as obrigações contratuais relativas às especificações, qualidade, custos e prazos sejam atendidas;
  • Consolidar e divulgar as informações do projeto (diagramas, cronogramas, descrições de atividades, planilha de custos, relatórios entre outros), visando o desenvolvimento de produtos após cada fase;
  • Acompanhar as etapas do projeto e comparar com o escopo proposto (cronograma, custos, redefinições do projeto, etc.) verificando o valor do orçamento do projeto dentro das especificações da proposta comercial.

title: Supply Chain and Demand Planning Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Supply Chain and Demand Planning Analyst to join our dynamic team. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional looking to develop their skills in demand planning, logistics, and operations within a luxury cosmetics company.

You will be responsible for providing direct support to the Supply Chain Coordinator, assisting with tracking logistics and importation processes, and ensuring the accuracy of the information that forms the basis for the department's strategic decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning Support

  • Update spreadsheets and control tools used for tracking sales forecasts.
  • Assist in preparing materials and reports for S&OP (Sales & Operations Planning) meetings.

Reporting

  • Extract data from ERP and BI systems to generate routine reports on inventory levels, stock coverage, and sales performance.
  • Perform initial analyses to identify deviations and trends, communicating findings to the Coordinator.

Inventory Management & Logistics

  • Monitor stock levels at the warehouse and points of sale, helping to identify risks of stock-outs or excess inventory.
  • Support the inventory count process (cycle and full counts) and assist with stock reconciliation.
  • Assist in tracking day-to-day warehouse operations to ensure orders are processed correctly.

Importation & Invoicing Process

  • Track the status of import shipments, keeping timelines updated and communicating any potential delays.
  • Organize and file the necessary documentation for importation processes.
  • Support the invoicing process for wholesale and retail channels, including the management and control of free items (marketing materials, samples, and testers).

Qualifications & Skills

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Production Engineering, Foreign Trade, or a related field.

Experience:

  • Previous experience (including internships) in supply chain, planning, logistics, or data analysis is a plus.
  • Interest in the cosmetics, CPG, or retail industry is desirable.

Technical Skills:

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel is essential, including formulas, Pivot Tables, and VLOOKUP.
  • Familiar with ERP systems (e.g., TOTVS, SAP) is a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Good analytical skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Proactive, organized, and capable of managing multiple tasks.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • A strong desire to learn and grow in the Supply Chain field.

Languages: Fluency in Portuguese and Intermediate English (for reading emails and documents) are required.

title: Senior Recruitment Consultant – International Projects, Remote (Brazil Based)
description:
Are you a standout recruitment professional who’s passionate about business development and building lasting client partnerships? Do you love working with autonomy—yet crave the energy and support of a best-in-class, international team? If you’re ready for your career to go global, your opportunity starts here.


Remote People isn’t just another agency—we’re the bridge connecting exceptional talent with future-focused companies in over 150 countries. We build world-class teams, drive innovation, and empower growth for clients and candidates across the globe with tailored, fully compliant solutions.


What You'll Achieve with Us


  • Own Major Client Relationships: Take the lead with America-based clients, managing recruitment projects spanning the Americas and truly making an impact on their business success.
  • Recruit End-to-End: Head up projects from sourcing and talent mapping to interviews and placements—delivering only the best talent every step of the way.
  • Drive Business Growth: Join forces with our Americas sales team to pitch tailored solutions, win new business, and expand our footprint in the Americas market.
  • Collaborate Across Borders: Work hand-in-hand with Global recruitment experts to ensure seamless, high-quality service and delighted clients.
  • Be a Trusted Advisor: Share strategic insights on talent markets, salary benchmarks, and best hiring practices—becoming a valued thought partner for your customers.


Who Thrives Here?


  • You bring at least 4 years of recruitment or consulting experience (agency background preferred).
  • You are a proven business developer and relationship builder—clients love partnering with you for the long term.
  • You have deep knowledge of the LATAM talent market, hiring trends, and employment regulations.
  • You are fluent in English and Portuguese —both written and spoken.
  • You thrive on autonomy, are self-driven, and take ownership of results in a fast-paced, remote setup.


Why Choose Remote People?


  • Work 100% Remotely: Freedom to work anywhere in Brazil—no commutes, just results.
  • Flexible Schedule: Shape your workday around your life and perform at your best.
  • Truly Global Projects: Step into high-impact searches and collaborate with leaders and teams from around the world.
  • Top Tools, Top Compensation: Access the latest tech and a competitive package built for high performers.
  • Empowering Culture: Your voice is heard, your ideas matter, and your growth is our priority.


Ready to Go Further?


If you’re energized by global impact, empowered by autonomy, and eager to work alongside the best in international recruiting—apply now . Join Remote People and help us shape the future of talent across the Americas and beyond.

title: Senior Software Engineer (L5)
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • 3+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Inside Sales Account Executive, North America
description:
Location: anywhere in LATAM


JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :


  • Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Craft and execute your territory sales plan & progress opportunities in the pipeline.
  • Provide product demos to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians in North America.
  • Proactively communicate with clients and users through emails and calls.
  • Analyze trends and make data driven decisions on priorities in your work.
  • Work effectively with other teams such as marketing to deliver on sales targets, team projects and campaigns.


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
  • Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Experienced with Salesforce and platforms such as Hubspot.
  • Confidence in dealing with clients and product users.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, results-oriented and willing to learn new skills.
  • A drive to succeed and a proven ability to be resilient and overcome challenges.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Desenvolvimento Python Pleno AWS - 124355
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e manter aplicações complexas em Python, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança. Contribuir com a arquitetura e design de sistemas de grande porte, visando soluções robustas e eficientes. Colaborar ativamente em todas as fases do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a implementação e manutenção. Mentorizar e compartilhar conhecimentos com desenvolvedores mais juniores, contribuindo para o crescimento do time. Implementar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados), garantindo a qualidade do código. Trabalhar com integração contínua e pipelines de DevOps, promovendo a automação de processos. Participar de code reviews, propondo melhorias e boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Manter-se atualizado com novas tecnologias e práticas do mercado, trazendo inovações para os projetos. Requisitos: Experiência sólida de 5+ anos com desenvolvimento em Python. Profundo conhecimento de frameworks como Django, Flask, FastAPI ou similares. Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, microserviços e sistemas distribuídos. Sólidos conhecimentos de bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis). Experiência com testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e ferramentas de integração contínua (Jenkins, GitLab CI). Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing, como AWS, Google Cloud ou Azure. Conhecimento de práticas de segurança em desenvolvimento de software. Familiaridade com containerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes). Habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação para interagir com áreas multidisciplinares. Capacidade de analisar e resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Desenvolvimento Python Pleno AWS - 124355
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e manter aplicações complexas em Python, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança. Contribuir com a arquitetura e design de sistemas de grande porte, visando soluções robustas e eficientes. Colaborar ativamente em todas as fases do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a implementação e manutenção. Mentorizar e compartilhar conhecimentos com desenvolvedores mais juniores, contribuindo para o crescimento do time. Implementar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados), garantindo a qualidade do código. Trabalhar com integração contínua e pipelines de DevOps, promovendo a automação de processos. Participar de code reviews, propondo melhorias e boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Manter-se atualizado com novas tecnologias e práticas do mercado, trazendo inovações para os projetos. Requisitos: Experiência sólida de 5+ anos com desenvolvimento em Python. Profundo conhecimento de frameworks como Django, Flask, FastAPI ou similares. Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, microserviços e sistemas distribuídos. Sólidos conhecimentos de bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis). Experiência com testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e ferramentas de integração contínua (Jenkins, GitLab CI). Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing, como AWS, Google Cloud ou Azure. Conhecimento de práticas de segurança em desenvolvimento de software. Familiaridade com containerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes). Habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação para interagir com áreas multidisciplinares. Capacidade de analisar e resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Cloud Platform Developer/Python
description:
Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.


Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Morumbi-Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Remote, but must be available for occasional visits to Morumbi-SP when requested by the client.

Must Have Skills

'Run functional activities for PTP(Procure to pay) such as Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites, support Developers in code remediation, new developments, run IT and integration testing, support user testing (UAT).


Will participate in SAP Tax Reform Project in a Lifescience Company, running activities for PTP(Procure to pay) in Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites.


Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, especially for NFe Inbound knowledge, Pricing and enhancements to supply processes, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects


Good Have to skills

'Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC, Sovos, One Source and Easyway.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

English advanced and Spanish Intermediate.


Key Responsabilities

'As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requirements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

Will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Owner of certain niche processes within broader domain area.

Experience in a Professional LifeScience/Pharma company is an asset.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Reimbursement of Certifications

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

  • 6 a 10 anos de experiência como desenvolvedor;

Requisitos da vaga

  • 6 a 10 anos de experiência como desenvolvedor;
  • 4 anos de experiência profissional com Laravel + PHP;
  • 2 anos com experiência profissional Vue.js;
  • Experiência com Bootstrap;
  • Experiência na construção, manutenção e documentação de APIs;
  • Experiência com MySQL;
  • Experiência com controle de versões;


Desejável (não eliminatório, mas um plus)

  • Experiência Docker;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de software, como SOLID, Clean Code, PSRs;
  • Experiência com serviços da AWS.


Principais funções

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades usando Laravel, PHP, Vue.js e Bootstrap;
  • Dar manutenção para funcionalidades já existentes;
  • Seguir os padrões de qualidade de software definidos pelo setor;
  • Participar de conversas de alinhamento do setor;
  • Ajudar na integração, homologação e lançamentos das funcionalidades.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
A inovaVoip é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em soluções de comunicação em nuvem e telefonia VoIP. Nosso foco é oferecer plataformas estáveis, seguras e escaláveis, desenvolvidas com tecnologias modernas como React, Next.js, Node.js, Supabase e Docker .

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack para atuar na melhoria e otimização de um sistema já existente , preparando-o para produção e escalabilidade . Buscamos um(a) profissional comprometido(a), com visão técnica, responsabilidade e desejo de crescimento.

Responsabilidades
  • Revisar, higienizar e otimizar o código existente, aplicando boas práticas e padrões de arquitetura.
  • Diagnosticar e corrigir erros, gargalos e falhas de lógica.
  • Aprimorar performance e segurança das principais páginas e fluxos do sistema.
  • Garantir o correto funcionamento de permissões, limites e planos de uso.
  • Preparar o ambiente de execução e deployment utilizando Docker e Docker Compose .
  • Implementar melhorias em integrações Realtime (Supabase, Redis, WebRTC).
  • Colaborar com revisões técnicas e propor soluções estruturadas.
  • Contribuir com documentação e padronização de código.
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Experiência com React (19.x) e Next.js (15.x) .
  • Domínio em TypeScript (5.x) e boas práticas de tipagem.
  • Experiência com Node.js (20.x) e Express.js .
  • Conhecimento em PostgreSQL / Supabase .
  • Experiência com Redis para cache e gerenciamento de sessões.
  • Habilidade em Docker / Docker Compose .
  • Experiência com Git / GitHub .
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e responsabilidade com prazos e entregas.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com WebRTC e Asterisk (VoIP) .
  • Vivência com Supabase Realtime ou Sockets .
  • Conhecimento em TailwindCSS e Radix UI .
  • Familiaridade com Clean Code , SOLID e Design Patterns .
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços e CI/CD .
Perfil Ideal

Buscamos um(a) profissional com senso de responsabilidade, organização e mentalidade de melhoria contínua.

Valorizamos pessoas proativas, com iniciativa e comprometimento em entregar resultados de qualidade, que queiram crescer junto com o projeto e influenciar sua evolução técnica .

Modelo de Trabalho
  • 100% remoto
  • Horário flexível (foco em entregas)
  • Contratação PJ / Freelancer
  • Início imediato
Faixa de Remuneração

R$ 6.000 a R$ 10.000 (PJ / mês)

A faixa pode variar conforme experiência e nível técnico.

O que oferecemos
  • Liberdade técnica para propor melhorias e novas soluções.
  • Participação direta em decisões de arquitetura.
  • Acompanhamento técnico e feedback contínuo.
  • Cultura de colaboração e comunicação transparente.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em produto real.

Interessados devem enviar portfólio, GitHub ou LinkedIn com exemplos de projetos utilizando React , Next.js , Node.js , Supabase e Docker .

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Como Senior DevOps Engineer na área de DTI da Sankhya, você terá a missão de contribuir significativamente com a evolução da nossa cultura de DevOps, elevando a maturidade de processos, ferramentas e práticas. Essa posição terá forte impacto estratégico na estabilidade, automação e governança dos nossos ambientes, sendo referência técnica e parceira das áreas de desenvolvimento, segurança e operações.


Se você busca desafios complexos, autonomia e a oportunidade de influenciar a arquitetura e as práticas de engenharia em escala, essa vaga é para você.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Diagnóstico e plano de ação para maturidade DevOps: mapear processos, ferramentas e práticas atuais, identificando gargalos e propondo um plano de evolução com prioridades claras para eficiência, automação e confiabilidade;
  • Estabilização e automação dos pipelines de CI/CD: puxar a revisão, padronização e automação de pipelines, garantindo versionamento, rastreabilidade e segurança das implantações, além de implementar práticas como blue/green deploy ou rollback automatizado;
  • Governança e confiabilidade dos ambientes: implementar processos e ferramentas que fortaleçam segurança, configuração e monitoramento, utilizando infraestrutura como código (ex.: Terraform), além de fomentar a cultura de observabilidade e resposta proativa a incidentes;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time de DevOps e promover boas práticas de engenharia em toda a organização;
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de performance e disponibilidade em sistemas distribuídos.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis ;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CI/CD e automação (Jenkins, GitLab, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, ArgoCD, etc.);
  • Vivência em infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares);
  • Conhecimento avançado em linguagens de scripting/automação (Python, Ruby, Shell Script);
  • Linux avançado (obrigatório) e experiência com Windows Server;
  • Fundamentos de redes, protocolos e segurança ;
  • Experiência em cloud computing (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e boas práticas de otimização de custo/performance;
  • Containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes );
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog ou similares).



Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

title: Calypso Functional FO-MO
description:
Project Description:

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Calypso practices.

We are a top-tier Calypso Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration.

We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered Calypso projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.


Project Description:

Support and additional build out (projects) for Calypso instance.


Responsibilities:

- Address and respond to production support issues and trouble shoot issues arising from day-to-day activities Calypso instance

- Provide support to FO and MO users on Calypso

- Configure, updated, optimize functional set up in Calypso

- Execute (where required) SOD/ EOD Scheduled Tasks

- Develop necessary functional solutions for Calypso instance as per requirements (if required)

- Monitor if market quotes fail to update Calypso system error messages

- Monitor feed & security definitions download, if reprocessing of trades needed or reprocessing of events

- Ensures supporting documents are complete, current, and appropriately stored

- Works closely with relevant business and technology stakeholders to ensure effective and efficient implementation of the project(s)

- Submits status reports to stakeholders; coordinates and provides updates to steering committees

- Collaboration with key functional or business stakeholders to achieve clear outcomes/deliverables in relation to the strategic and transformational book of work

- Manage deliverables ensuring transparency of risks, issues and dependencies that are fully aligned to functional / business owners


You might be acting also as a business analyst as well in order to help the team gathering and writing requirements, acceptance criteria.


A Sampling of Tasks Expected to be Performed:

1. Configuring Standard & Custom Interfaces within Calypso

2. Setting up Quote Feeds from Bloomberg

3. Set-up Holiday Calendar feed

4. Set-up Interest Rate Curves & other market data

5. Set-up Dividend Curves for Custom Index

6. Set-up Equity Volatility Surface feeds

7. Translate Historical Volatility of Volatility-controlled indexes to a Volatility Surface to be used in Calypso

8. Set-up pricing configuration & pricing parameters

9. Some end-of-day processing/monitoring needed


Skills Description:

• 3+ years of experience working in Capital Markets and Calypso

• Good knowledge of Financial products cross assets

- Expertise with a front-to-back Calypso derivatives solution, including accounting, is a must. Preferably with an insurance

industry focus.


Other Required Skills:

- Ability to work with little supervision, be a fast learner, self-motivated, team player, and collaborator with strong problem-solving

skills.

- Must be resourceful and demonstrate initiative in getting the job done.

- Good oral and written communication skills are essential.


- Ability to train and transfer knowledge to Guardian's business and technology stakeholders

• Proven track record of delivery of implementation / migration projects

• Proven experience in the development of Calypso integrations, reporting, and other technical aspects

- Experience of adherence to governance frameworks / implementation and handover to BAU

• Comprehensive knowledge of trade flow, trading systems and related concepts and technology, including valuation and client/market risk management

• Leadership skills

• Excellent analytical skills, understanding of project life cycles, and ability to act in an entrepreneurial manner to ensure the requirements from the business are gathered in the appropriate manner.

• Proven analytical, planning, problem solving and decision-making skills

• Comfortable with direct communication with all levels of technical and business resources

• Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously

• Experience with working in a highly collaborative and dynamic multi-team environment
